headline: A quiet morning — cash comfortably covers everything due
narrative: Nothing forced the agent's hand today. Meenakshi Steels' invoice clears the discount window, so paying now from cash captures the 2% early-payment discount worth ₹17,000 at no financing cost. Velan Logistics is paid on time from cash as well — not because the buffer requires it, but because Velan is a strategic supplier and there's no liquidity reason to delay. Coromandel Packaging's invoice isn't due for another two weeks, so it's held for now rather than paid early into a discount that isn't worth the liquidity it ties up.
key_assumptions: All open receivables are expected to collect on their scheduled dates
The bank line remains undrawn and available if needed
No hard obligation is within its risk window yet
tradeoffs: Held ₹2,65,000 in cash rather than capturing Coromandel's smaller discount, preserving liquidity for later in the month
would_change_if: If a receivable collects late, the buffer requirement rises and today's PAY_NOW calls may flip to DELAY or FINANCE_BANK
If Coromandel's liquidity stress rises, capturing its discount early becomes worth the tied-up cash
